deprecations.name: compact

replacement.name: size
replacement.usage: Use size="s" for compact rows and size="m" for the default row density.

deprecations.rationale: The shared size vocabulary describes row density and search-control scale together. The boolean compatibility spelling remains mapped to the small and medium size tiers throughout its deprecation window.
